statement: Every ambient-null based plane homeomorphism loop with pairwise commuting values has a jointly continuous based contraction, with jointly continuous inverses, in the centralizer of every subgroup commuting with that loop. The contraction is global across all orbit types. On every connected admissible surface, a class in the inclusion-induced centralizer fundamental-group kernel that has such a representative is zero; for hyperbolic surfaces the ambient kernel condition is automatic.
depends_on: C26 Polish open orbit-map theorem; C28 intrinsic orbit classification and evaluation continuity; C29 exact circle/two-point winding comparison; C32 null restriction to open plane subsets; C33 verified Hilbert--Smith product action; C37 exact three-word equality in the based universal cover and bounded residual method; ordinary covering lift uniqueness
manuscript_passages: Section 23, folios 140-141, scans 279-281; Part C(b) infinite-operator request; complete global commuting-value subcase of the exact C.12 level-zero comparison
depends_on_doubtful_reading: None. The actual abelian image on each orbit is proved to be the full transitive Lie group, the surface null-homotopy is lifted by an explicit product map, and all commutator deck transformations are shown to be constant by continuity.
notes: Abelian closure plus free transitive evaluation gives R or S1 on nonopen one-dimensional orbits, and R2 or R times S1 on open orbits. The original image equals its closure by transitivity and freeness. The same compact three-word isotopy family represents every fractional action, with based universal-cover endpoints retained; one-dimensional representations use the intermediate value theorem. The mixed orbit-type limit argument uses bounded integer residuals. At a circular limit the residual loops are null in their actual Lie images for every approximating orbit type, so two-point winding proves the real residual equation, including identity endpoints with nonzero based angle. The inverse loop gives exact inverse continuity. The product D2 times universal-cover lift proves the stated corollary for every admissible surface, retaining the actual operator lift group and descent. No reduction of a general centralizer loop to commuting values is asserted, and C12 remains Open. The corollary excludes the exact closed abelian subgroup B of C26 as a full centralizer: inclusion into every centralizer containing it kills its generating loop, and cannot identify its nonzero fundamental group with that of the centralizer.
